description: The Event Horizon is a student space publication at the University of Maryland covering the commercial, governmental, international, scientific, defense and economic sides of space.

sectionDescriptions.commercial: Launch companies, satellites and the private race to orbit.
sectionDescriptions.governmental: NASA, budgets, Congress and the policy that steers it all.
sectionDescriptions.international: What China, Europe, India and others are building.
sectionDescriptions.astronomy: New discoveries, telescopes and what's in the sky this week.
sectionDescriptions.defense-intelligence: Space Force, national security and the fight over orbit.
sectionDescriptions.space-economy: Markets, funding and the business of space.
